facts.claim: Vira Raja shot twenty-five Coorgs during the confrontation.
facts.quote: Vira Raja himself took his post at a window and fired upon the terror- stricken conspirators. They allowed themselves to be slaughtered like sheep. Vira Raja himself boasted of having shot twenty five of them.

facts.claim: Approximately three hundred Coorgs were killed in the palace yard.
facts.quote: Three hundred Coorgs, by his account, fell that morning in front of the palace. Coorg tradition says eight hundred.

facts.claim: The blood from the fallen Coorgs ran out of the palace yard like rain during a heavy monsoon day.
facts.quote: An old Jemadar, who had been eyewitness of the dreadful scene, said that the blood ran out of the palace yard as the rain in a heavy monsoon day.
